issue:2245.title: Crash after the opening scene on Linux with an AMD graphics card
issue:2245.summary: A player using Linux and an AMD Radeon RX 6600 XT reports that version 2.1.0 closes after the opening scene, before the Great Deku Tree appears. The report includes a graphics-driver reset. The cause and a fix have not been verified here.

issue:2298.title: Missing shopkeeper may stop early progress
issue:2298.summary: A Windows player reports that the Kokiri Shop cannot be used in version 2.1.0 because its shopkeeper is missing. This may prevent buying the Deku Shield needed to continue. This is a reported problem, not an independently reproduced finding.

issue:2412.title: The game slows down after travelling between areas
issue:2412.summary: A Windows player with an RTX 5070 reports that version 2.1.0 becomes much slower after travelling between areas. The report includes rising graphics-memory use, but its proposed cause has not been confirmed here.
